governing_spec.section: Section B: Journal Consumer Isolation & Old-Writer Retirement

transactional_cas_writes.implementation: services/governance/decision_journal.py: compare_and_set on GovernanceRecordStore with version tracking and _MAX_CAS_ATTEMPTS retry budget.

append_only_audit_with_diff.implementation: services/governance/decision_journal.py: patch_entry computes changedFields, oldValues, and newValues and puts append-only record to audit store.

durable_outbox_streaming.implementation: services/governance/decision_journal.py: outbox record store initialized and populated on entry creation and updates with decision_journal.entry.* event types.

tenant_and_user_isolation.implementation: Scoped get_entry, list_entries, create_entry, patch_entry, list_audit_events, and list_outbox_events across actor_id and tenant_id. Cross-tenant access strictly denied; private records isolated to authorized actor.

caller_supplied_id_collision_rejection.implementation: services/governance/decision_journal.py: create_entry raises DecisionJournalCollisionError when a supplied ID collides with another principal's or tenant's record. AgoraService maps to HTTP 409 Conflict.

controlled_legacy_migration.implementation: services/governance/migrations/journal_migration.py: JournalMigrationEngine with SHA-256 checksums, verify_migration_parity, dry-run mode, checkpointing, and conflict handling. Unscoped legacy rows excluded from tenant queries unless explicitly requested.

fresh_process_restart_parity.implementation: Restart parity verified in unit tests; backing stores persist to JSON/Postgres via build_decision_journal_stores without relying on in-memory mutable state.

architecture_doc.aggregate: agora_journal command_owner: governance_application, store_owner: governance_decision_journal_store, forbidden_writers: [_AGORA_JOURNAL_OVERLAY, _AGORA_STORE_JOURNAL_SLICE]
architecture_doc.routes: PATCH /bff/agora/journal/{param} and POST /bff/agora/journal mapped to governance_application / governance_decision_journal_store

no_dynamic_getattr.implementation: Removed __getattr__ from DecisionJournalOwnerAdapter; only typed query/command methods exposed. Test test_does_not_proxy_unrelated_attributes_via_getattr asserts AttributeError.

read_surface_cleanliness.implementation: ReadSurfacePorts.list_decision_journal_entries queries operations_consultation port. No mutation methods exposed on ReadSurfacePorts.
